criteria.primary: net-of-fees return beats buy-and-hold BTC over the window
criteria.quality: positive Sharpe on the equity curve
criteria.minimum_sample: at least 30 closed trades, else the result is not significant

hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The crypto universe is in a stressed cross‑asset regime with most signals showing negative composites and modest to negative expected shortfalls. While BTC shows a marginally positive edge and strong liquidity, the majority of altcoins have weak institutional scores, reduced liquidity, and fragile signals (especially BCH, DOGE, LTC, and the placeholder ETC). To preserve capital we tilt toward a risk‑off stance, scaling back overall exposure and nudging down convictions on the weaker assets.
